source_contract.question: Does an affine-E4 shape law organize the actual A/E/C/W response, or does the new shear require a different direction?
source_contract.primary: joint 4-coordinate affine-E4 same-N100 three-shape null, alpha=.01; full same-stream 12x12 covariance
source_contract.source_informed_secondary: N50-to-N100 coordinatewise profile transfer, with source uncertainty and free coordinate-specific area gains
source_contract.sampling: Same seed and counter block for all three shapes supplies common random permutations; no adaptively chosen support or new repetitions. Target comparisons share one dependency group.
source_contract.resource: Local Mac; three independent single-threaded engine processes. No Huawei access or rental.
source_contract.boundary: A new finite-N100 test. Neither a pass nor a failure identifies a continuum field. This freeze does not turn the old N50 model discovery into preregistered evidence. No broad validation campaign is assigned.

source_contract.question: Does the relative odd/even thermal shape and common-profile-coordinate failure persist when all periods are doubled?
source_contract.primary_readout: Same-area finite common profile transport J_m(U)-r_E J_m(D), m=1..6, with complete paired-batch covariance and fitted r_A/r_E uncertainty; use quotient-free polynomial form if source area is weak.
additional_readouts: fixed-p A/E/C/W response and previously defined affine-E4 and free-common-secant scores
full-p and central thermal-window residual moments, keeping the two scopes separate
N100-to-N400 relative-shape change with independent source-block covariance; no imposed area power
source_contract.sampling: Same seed and counter block across the three N400 shapes. Independent of the N100 seed/block. One correlated N400 dependency group; no adaptive sample extension in this run.
source_contract.resource: Local Mac, three single-threaded engine processes. No new server or GPU rental.
source_contract.geometry: Every N100 period entry is multiplied by two. Same tau and rational O; first Smith(2,200), second Smith(10,40) for every pair. This is a homothetic scale, not an N200 Gaussian-norm change.
source_contract.boundary: A prospective scale follow-up to an exploratory N100 mechanism. Numerical outcomes are not presumed; a weak target does not establish recovery of a model. Full-p results do not by themselves identify a critical-window field. No old-test campaign is assigned.

boundary: Fixed orders and ordinal landmarks, not selected windows. N100/N400 inputs had previously informed the width conjecture; this is a mechanism decomposition, not independent evidence from new samples. Signed-profile moments, not probability-law cumulants. The six peak coordinates exclude redundant height ratios from their omnibus score. Canonical peaks retain finite-N smoothing and are not literal extrema of the noisy rank-step function.
